entities.name: Priscus of Epirus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Priscus of Epirus, also known as Priscus the Thesprotian and Priscus the Molossian, was a Neoplatonist philosopher and theurgist, a colleague of Maximus of Ephesus, and a friend of the Emperor Julian.
